# High-Performance Leadership and Management

## Software Delivery Performance as Business Driver

Software delivery performance drives organizational performance measures including profitability, productivity, market share, efficiency, effectiveness, customer satisfaction, and achieving mission goals. Since nearly every company relies on software, delivery performance is critical to any organization doing business today. The ability to deliver quality software at high tempo with stability is a key value driver and differentiator for all organizations, regardless of size or industry vertical.

## Key Capabilities and Practices

The research identified key capabilities that contribute to software delivery performance in statistically significant and meaningful ways. Software delivery performance is affected by many factors, including leadership, tools, automation, and a culture of continuous learning and improvement.

## Transformation Through Sustained Effort

High performance cannot be bought or copied. Organizations must develop their own capabilities while pursuing a path that fits their particular context and goals. This requires sustained effort, investment, focus, and time. The research findings are unequivocal that the results are worth this investment.

## Research Foundation

The findings are based on several years of surveying technology professionals and writing the State of DevOps Reports with Puppet. The research included studying technology transformations, publishing results in peer review, and working with colleagues and peers assessing and transforming their own organizations.
